title: Checks flagged 'a miss costs standing' never name which faction is at risk beforehand; the specific reputation hit (e.g. '(the Gray Church -1)', '(the Ironbound -1)') only appears after a failed roll.
where: The Ironbound Chapterhouse ('make the truth public'), The Priory of the Gray Church ('lay the tablet against his words'), The Regent's Chambers ('the founding ledger')
